prompt_head:
Role: Solutions Architect at Kobie
<requirements>
[r1] (required, years_experience) 3-5 years of experience in solutions architecture, business requirements ana

assessments.note: Met: 4+ years systems architect experience and integration blueprint design.
Partial: project mgmt cert and architecture work, but no explicit BRD/SC/Epic docs.
Partial: data validation pipelines shown, not specific cost estimate validation.
Missing: no evidence of Agile/Scrum or waterfall methodology use.
Met: built multiple demo generators and proposal‑type solutions.
Partial: coordinated integration modules and data pipelines, but no clear multi‑team dependency management.
Partial: error‑spotting experience, not explicit scope‑drift risk handling.
Missing: no loyalty marketing program knowledge shown.
Partial: inventory and sales experience, lacking clear retail/financial services delivery.
Partial: CRM and integration demos, not specific MarTech platform familiarity.
Met: remote/cloud‑based development and deployment experience.
Missing: no evidence of quarterly travel capability.

output.verdict_line: Candidate meets core technical requirements but lacks proven Agile methodology experience and travel availability.
top_gaps: Travel up to once per quarter
Document business requirements into BRDs/SCDs/Epic briefs
